free_tier.stated: We place no absolute limit within the 2-month period on the total volume of user data that may exist in a data upload area at any one time and are keen to accommodate the largest submissions where possible.
free_tier.notes: However, we strongly encourage continuous data submissions where files are uploaded and submitted in small patches of few Terabytes or less and expect that volumes would not exceed 10 Terabytes under normal circumstances.

per_object_cap.stated: No per-object cap documented in published terms; absence is not an unlimited claim.
per_object_cap.notes: The upload guide sets no per-file byte ceiling: it states no absolute limit on the total volume in an upload area, with only a fair-use expectation of a few terabytes per patch and volumes not exceeding 10 terabytes normally.

retention.stated: We expect any given data file to remain in a data upload area for no longer than 2 months before the instruction is given by the user to submit the file.
retention.notes: Upload areas hold data only in transit; files left more than 2 months may be routinely deleted, while once submitted data can be released immediately or held private and is kept in ENA.

egress.terms: Unmetered and anonymous. ftp.sra.ebi.ac.uk is CORS-open (`Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *`) and already served through Cloudflare (`Server: cloudflare`), so CF is in front by default.

tooling: Webin-CLI (github.com/enasequence/webin-cli), plus plain FTP/Aspera. Read side is plain HTTPS/FTP with HTTP range support. Works with rclone's http/`sftp` remotes and curl.
chaining: One Webin account = unlimited studies. The upload area is a transit buffer (10 TB documented expectation), while *published* accessions are permanent and unmetered on the read side. Multiply across accounts/centres; read side needs no account at all, so the fetch workload is uncapped regardless of how many deposit accounts exist.

limits.value: While we attempt to remind users of this policy at the 2 months time point we reserve the right to routinely delete any data files that persist in them for more than 2 months.

limits_note: per-object-cap: none documented per file; per-request volume soft-capped at ~10 TB per 2-month window per upload area, and upload areas are not backed up. Retention: transit area purged after 2 months if not submitted; once submitted, ENA is permanent. Binding constraint on READ is per-ip-shaping: single stream 45 KB/s, 8 parallel ranged GETs 430 KB/s (9.6x).
